'''Kyryll's World''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Pui-ui" /> located in the [[Kyryll's World system/Legends|Kyryll's World system]], a part of the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Pui-ui]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="CSWE Pui-ui" /> members of which communicated in the [[Pui-ui language]]<ref name="Guide3" /> and which was known to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by [[671 BBY]].<ref name="Evocar">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek05/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part IV: ''Evocar'')|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kyryll's World was introduced in the [[1984]] reference book ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'' by [[Raymond L. Velasco]].<ref name="Guide1">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Kyryll's World [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square S-7.<ref name="TEA" />
